payload.name: elmah.io MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: elmah.io MCP helps users inspect their elmah.io account from ChatGPT by listing accessible logs and organizations, analyzing recent and frequent log messages, reviewing deployments, checking uptime and heartbeat status, and retrieving detailed error context for debugging production issues.
payload.longDescription: elmah.io MCP 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中检查自己的 elmah.io 账户，包括列出可访问的日志和组织、分析近期及频繁出现的日志消息、查看部署、检查可用性和心跳状态，以及获取用于调试生产问题的详细错误背景。

payload.name: Strix
payload.description: AI 渗透测试与漏洞分诊
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Strix brings AI penetration testing and vulnerability management into ChatGPT. Review recent tests, prioritize open findings by severity, and inspect evidence and remediation steps. Start tests against your authorized web applications, APIs, and repositories; retest findings; and open fix pull requests or tickets through connected integrations. Check pull request security reviews and supply-chain findings, manage recurring schedules and assets, and summarize your workspace's security activity. Sign in with your Strix account using OAuth. Access follows your Strix workspace role and resource permissions. Starting tests, retests, reviews, and other security workflows may use Strix credits and send traffic to the selected targets. Some capabilities require an eligible Strix plan.
payload.longDescription: Strix 将 AI 渗透测试和漏洞管理引入 ChatGPT。查看近期测试，按严重程度排列未解决的发现，并检查证据和修复步骤。针对你获准测试的 Web 应用、API 和代码库启动测试；重新测试发现的问题；并通过已连接的集成创建修复拉取请求或工单。检查拉取请求的安全审查和供应链发现，管理定期计划和资产，并总结工作区的安全活动。使用 Strix 账户通过 OAuth 登录。访问权限遵循你在 Strix 工作区中的角色和资源权限。启动测试、重新测试、审查及其他安全工作流可能会消耗 Strix 额度，并向所选目标发送流量。部分功能需要符合条件的 Strix 方案。

payload.name: QtMesh Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QtMesh Cloud helps users inspect 3D asset quality from ChatGPT. Users can list their projects, review scan summaries, inspect findings and scan reports, check quality gate settings, update owner-scoped quality gates, and control whether a project's public report is visible.
payload.longDescription: QtMesh Cloud 可帮助用户直接从 ChatGPT 检查 3D 资源质量。用户可以列出项目、查看扫描摘要、检查发现的问题和扫描报告、查看质量门设置、更新所有者范围内的质量门，并控制项目公开报告是否可见。

payload.name: Openlayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Openlayer helps teams inspect AI projects, data sources, traces, tests, evaluation results, and governance controls, and manage private workspace resources through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Openlayer 帮助团队通过 ChatGPT 检查 AI 项目、数据源、追踪记录、测试、评估结果和治理控制，并管理私有工作区资源。

payload.name: Unbounce - Classic Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Unbounce account to create and edit landing pages, add A/B test variants, set traffic splits, and check page performance without leaving the chat. 
Describe the page you want and Unbounce will build it; ask for a new variant, a headline change, or a conversion report and it's handled in your account.
Works with your existing Unbounce pages, domains, and page groups. Requires an Unbounce account and the Classic Builder.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Unbounce 账户，即可在聊天中创建和编辑着陆页、添加 A/B 测试变体、设置流量分配并查看页面效果。
描述你想要的页面，Unbounce 就会为你构建；你也可以要求创建新变体、修改标题或生成转化报告，相关操作会在你的账户中完成。
可与现有 Unbounce 页面、域名和页面组配合使用。需要 Unbounce 账户及 Classic Builder。

payload.name: Greptile
payload.description: 审查代码与 PR 反馈
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI code review agent for GitHub and GitLab. View Greptile's PR review comments, run reviews on your working branch, and search your organization's knowledge base and coding patterns, directly from Codex.
payload.longDescription: 面向 GitHub 和 GitLab 的 AI 代码审查代理。直接在 Codex 中查看 Greptile 的 PR 审查评论、审查当前工作分支，并搜索组织的知识库和编码模式。

payload.name: Embrasure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Embrasure helps ChatGPT and Codex investigate silent data failures without querying arbitrary warehouse rows. Inspect table health and Scout evidence, trace table- and column-level lineage, identify downstream services and owners, and understand blast radius before a change. Reads respect workspace permissions. Scout changes always require preview and explicit approval.
payload.longDescription: Embrasure帮助ChatGPT和Codex在不查询任意仓库行的情况下调查静默数据故障。检查表健康状态并侦察证据，追踪表级和列级数据血统，识别下游服务及负责人，了解变更前的影响范围。读取操作会尊重工作区权限。Scout更改始终需要预览和明确审批。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Data warehouse setup, Source connections and sync, SQL queries, Charts and dashboards, Shared business definitions

payload.name: SCVD x402 Verifier
payload.description: 检查 x402 支付门槛和回执
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SCVD x402 Verifier checks payment challenges without paying, verifies signed x402 offers and receipts, reads recorded endpoint readiness, explains defect classes, and checks SCVD artifact signatures. Results describe evidence and limits; they do not establish delivery or guarantee a provider. All tools are free and no wallet or login is required. Calls record usage statistics. Readiness lookups for eligible hosts with no recorded probe add the hostname and ask count to a public queue for a later discovery sweep; caller identity is not included in that queue.
payload.longDescription: SCVD x402 Verifier 无需付款即可检查支付挑战、验证已签名的 x402 报价和回执、读取已记录的端点就绪状态、解释缺陷类别，并检查 SCVD 工件签名。结果说明证据及其局限；它们不能证明已交付，也不保证服务提供方。所有工具均免费，无需钱包或登录。调用会记录使用统计。对于尚无探测记录的符合条件主机，就绪状态查询会将主机名和查询次数加入公开队列，供后续发现扫描使用；队列中不包含调用者身份。

payload.name: Limrun
payload.description: 在云模拟器上测试应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want.
payload.longDescription: Limrun 为你的智能体提供云端 iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器。只需提出所需设备，几秒钟内即可就绪；你还可以选择预先安装自己的应用。

payload.name: qBraid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: qBraid helps users explore quantum devices, validate and simulate circuits, submit quantum jobs, and inspect results. Users can manage cloud compute, inspect notebooks and software environments, browse qBook courses, enroll in courses, and review learner progress when authorized. It also supports organization membership and credit workflows, billing summaries, and support requests. Credit purchases and course creation or redeployment are unavailable through this app. Some actions spend existing credits, change access, or send messages, and support content can be shared with support services.
payload.longDescription: qBraid 可帮助用户探索量子设备、验证和模拟电路、提交量子作业并检查结果。经授权后，用户还可以管理云计算资源、检查笔记本和软件环境、浏览 qBook 课程、报名课程并查看学习进度。它还支持组织成员管理和额度工作流、账单摘要及支持请求。此应用无法购买额度，也无法创建或重新部署课程。某些操作会消耗现有额度、更改访问权限或发送消息；支持内容可能会分享给支持服务提供方。

payload.name: LabWired
payload.description: 在虚拟芯片上运行固件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required. The same firmware binary that flashes to real silicon runs in the simulator, so results are reproducible enough to debug and to gate CI on. LabWired validates your wiring before it runs, lists the boards and components it supports, compiles firmware from source, and opens a live lab view embedded in ChatGPT where you can see GPIO, serial output, and peripherals respond in real time.
payload.longDescription: LabWired 可在微控制器（ARM Cortex-M、RISC-V 和 ESP32）的确定性仿真环境中运行真实嵌入式固件，整个过程都在对话中完成。选择开发板，为 MCU 连接传感器、显示屏和总线，编译固件，并在交互式硬件实验室中运行和观察——无需实体开发板。烧录到真实芯片上的固件二进制文件也能在模拟器中运行，因此结果可重复，足以用于调试和 CI 门禁检查。LabWired 会在运行前验证接线，列出支持的开发板和组件，从源代码编译固件，并在 ChatGPT 中打开嵌入式实时实验室视图，让你实时观察 GPIO、串口输出和外设的响应。

payload.name: Better Design
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
When ChatGPT builds you an app, a website or a page, it often looks generic and misses how people will use it. Better Design is a design harness that helps ChatGPT get both right.

Pick a look. Describe your product, and Better Design shows you design systems that fit it, such as calm and trustworthy for a finance app. A design system is the set of colors, fonts, buttons and cards that makes a product look like one brand. You choose one, and ChatGPT builds with it.

Make your own. Describe the feel you want, or share your website, and Better Design creates a custom design system in a few minutes.

Get the experience right. Better Design tells ChatGPT how sign-up, onboarding, forms, search, checkout and error messages should work, and what each screen should say.

Check the result. Better Design reviews what ChatGPT built for the problems people notice: text that is hard to read, buttons that are hard to find, screens that ask for too much at once, and words only insiders understand.
payload.longDescription:
当ChatGPT为你构建应用、网站或页面时，往往显得过于普通，未能体现实际使用场景。
Better Design是一个设计工具，能帮助ChatGPT同时实现外观与体验的精准呈现。

选择外观。
描述你的产品特性，Better Design会展示适配的设计系统，例如为金融类应用提供平静可信的视觉风格。
设计系统包含颜色、字体、按钮和卡片等元素，这些构成了产品的品牌视觉特征。
你可以任选其一，ChatGPT将基于该系统进行开发。

自定义设计。
描述你期望的视觉感受，或上传现有网站，Better Design将在数分钟内生成定制化设计系统。

优化使用体验。
Better Design会指导ChatGPT如何设计注册流程、引导机制、表单交互、搜索功能、结账流程和错误提示，以及每个界面的具体文案。

验证最终效果。
Better Design会检查ChatGPT生成内容是否符合用户常见关注点：难以阅读的文字、难以发现的按钮、一次性要求过多信息的界面，以及仅内部人员理解的术语。

payload.name: Tiniest Cloud
payload.description: 部署带登录功能的 Web 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tiniest Cloud hosts static web apps and gives each one sign-in, per-user storage, realtime, push notifications, scheduled jobs and a language model with nothing to configure. From a conversation you can deploy a folder and get a live URL, share the app with someone by email, roll back to an earlier version, connect a third-party API without putting its key in the page, schedule recurring work, and put an app on your own domain.
payload.longDescription: Tiniest Cloud 可托管静态 Web 应用，并为每个应用提供登录、用户级存储、实时功能、推送通知、定时任务和语言模型，无需任何配置。你可以在对话中部署一个文件夹并获得在线 URL，通过电子邮件与他人共享应用，将应用回滚到早期版本，在不把密钥放进页面的情况下连接第三方 API，安排周期性工作，并将应用部署到自己的域名。

payload.name: AiAkiv Memory
payload.description: AI 智能体的共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AiAkiv is long-term memory that AI agents and teammates share over MCP. It saves the important parts of your conversations as a knowledge graph and recalls them across sessions, tools, and teammates — so context one AI saves, the next one picks up, and a whole team works from one shared memory instead of scattered private chats. Save with an explicit command ("ak save"), recall by meaning with semantic search. Hosted remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; Korean and English supported.
payload.longDescription: AiAkiv 是 AI 智能体与团队成员通过 MCP 共享的长期记忆。它将对话中的重要部分保存为知识图谱，并在不同会话、工具和团队成员之间回忆这些内容——一个 AI 保存的上下文，另一个 AI 就能接续使用，整个团队基于同一份共享记忆工作，而非依靠分散的私人聊天。通过明确指令（“ak save”）保存，使用语义搜索按含义回忆。采用托管的远程 MCP 服务器和 OAuth 登录；支持韩语和英语。

payload.name: Tessryx
payload.description: 构建并托管在线 Web 应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and host live web apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

The main workflows the tools support:
- Author a JSON Schema, then datafiles validated against it. The same schema generates an editing interface, so a non-technical person can maintain the content afterwards without an agent.
- Author workflows that return HTML or JSON, and bind them to public URLs as dynamic endpoints with edge caching. One endpoint serves both a rendered page and the API routes that page's own JavaScript calls.
- Define parameterized HTTP calls to external systems, with credentials held as write-only secrets the assistant can reference but never read.
- Schedule workflows on a cron or interval so data recomputes on its own.
- Claim and verify a custom domain and serve any of the above from it.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1; there are no API keys for the user to manage.
payload.longDescription:
Tessryx 为智能体提供构建空间。它可以在聊天中创建真实网站、API 或内部工具所需的数据、逻辑、页面和定时任务，并将其托管在用户自己域名的公开 URL 上。用户无需部署生成的代码，也无需在本地运行任何程序。

工具支持的主要工作流：
- 编写 JSON Schema，再创建通过该架构验证的数据文件。同一架构还会生成编辑界面，让非技术人员之后无需智能体也能维护内容。
- 编写可返回 HTML 或 JSON 的工作流，并将其绑定到带边缘缓存的公开动态端点。一个端点同时提供渲染页面，以及该页面自身 JavaScript 调用的 API 路由。
- 定义带参数的外部系统 HTTP 调用，凭据以只写密钥的形式保存，助手可以引用但无法读取。
- 按 cron 或时间间隔安排工作流，使数据自动重新计算。
- 认领并验证自定义域名，并通过该域名提供上述任意内容。

身份验证采用 OAuth 2.1；用户无需管理 API 密钥。

payload.name: Tuist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tuist helps teams inspect Xcode, Gradle, and Bazel build data, test results, cache activity, previews, runner jobs, and project configuration. It also supports authorized account setup and selected test-case updates.
payload.longDescription: Tuist 帮助团队检查 Xcode、Gradle 和 Bazel 构建数据、测试结果、缓存活动、预览、运行器作业及项目配置。它还支持经授权的账户设置和部分测试用例更新。

payload.name: Better Stack
payload.description: 为 AI 智能体提供可观测性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Observability for AI agents: query your logs, traces, metrics, and errors with SQL, build dashboards and chart alerts, manage uptime monitors, respond to incidents, see who's on-call, and publish status page reports. You can also create and link error issues in Linear or Jira and search Better Stack's docs without leaving the chat. Connects to your Better Stack account.
payload.longDescription: 为 AI 智能体提供可观测性：通过 SQL 查询日志、追踪、指标和错误，构建控制面板和图表告警，管理可用性监控，响应事件，查看值班人员，并发布状态页报告。你还可以在 Linear 或 Jira 中创建和关联错误问题，并搜索 Better Stack 文档，无需离开聊天。连接到你的 Better Stack 账号。

payload.name: RepoLore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RepoLore helps developers understand why public GitHub code exists by tracing files and line ranges through commits, pull requests, issues, patches, and regression evidence.
payload.longDescription: RepoLore 帮助开发者了解公开 GitHub 代码存在的原因，方法是沿着提交、拉取请求、问题、补丁和回归证据追踪文件及代码行范围。

payload.name: LaunchDarkly
payload.description: 功能开关、AI 配置和指标
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage LaunchDarkly feature flags, AgentControl Configs (AI agent prompts/models), experiments, guarded and automated rollouts, segments, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and observability data (logs, traces, errors, sessions) directly from chat. Create and target flags, run and analyze experiments, configure AI agent prompts and tools, build dashboards and alerts, and investigate production issues without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 直接在聊天中管理 LaunchDarkly 功能开关、AgentControl 配置（AI 代理提示词/模型）、实验、受保护和自动化发布、分群、指标、仪表板、告警及可观测性数据（日志、追踪、错误、会话）。创建并定位功能开关，运行和分析实验，配置 AI 代理提示词和工具，构建仪表板和告警，并在不离开对话的情况下调查生产问题。

payload.name: Termalin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path. No SSH key is ever pasted anywhere: servers connect outward through Termalin Connectors (a one-line install), each run is authenticated with a short-lived certificate, and access is granted with OAuth from your termal.in account. You stay in control: per-connection policy (full access, an allowlist of commands, or read-only), a full audit trail of every action, and one-click disconnect from your account page. Works alongside the Termalin desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) and web cabinet, but needs neither to be open.

To get started you need a termal.in account (Pro, Team or trial) with at least one Connector enrolled (Settings → Connectors, a one-line install) and a verified email.
payload.longDescription:
Termalin 可将你的服务器连接到聊天中。你可以要求 ChatGPT 检查磁盘空间、查看日志末尾、重启服务、编辑配置或安装软件包；它会通过 SSH 运行实际命令，并通过 SFTP 读取或写入你已注册服务器上的文件，然后在对话中汇报结果。它还可以通过同一安全通道列出数据库表，并运行只读查询或完整查询。无需在任何地方粘贴 SSH 密钥：服务器通过 Termalin Connectors（一行安装命令）主动向外连接；每次运行都使用短期证书进行身份验证；访问权限通过你的 termal.in 账户中的 OAuth 授予。你始终可以掌控访问：为每个连接设置策略（完全访问、命令允许列表或只读）、查看每项操作的完整审计记录，并可在账户页面一键断开连接。它可与 Termalin 桌面应用（Windows/macOS/Linux）和网页版控制台配合使用，但无需打开其中任何一个。

开始使用需要 termal.in 账户（Pro、Team 或试用版），至少注册一个 Connector（Settings → Connectors，通过一行命令安装），并完成电子邮件验证。

payload.name: MacroDroid Macro Builder
payload.summaryOriginal: Build a macro by describing it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the automation you want in everyday language and get a complete MacroDroid macro back, ready to import on your Android phone.

MacroDroid is the Android automation app used daily by over a million users to automate their device with triggers, actions and constraints: silence the phone in meetings, turn off WiFi when the battery is low, read messages aloud while driving, send your location when you get home, and thousands more.

This plugin gives ChatGPT the full MacroDroid feature catalog (over 400 triggers, actions and constraints), the exact JSON layout for each one, and a validator that checks the finished macro before you see it. Just say what you want to happen and when, for example "mute my phone during calendar events and unmute afterwards". ChatGPT picks the right features, writes the macro and validates it.

Import the result by saving it as a .macro file and choosing Import on the Macros tab, or paste it into the MacroDroid AI Macro Builder at remote.macrodroid.com to send it straight to your phone.

No account or sign-in is needed. Nothing you type is stored by MacroDroid.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言描述你想要的自动化任务，即可获得完整的 MacroDroid 宏，可直接导入 Android 手机。

MacroDroid 是一款 Android 自动化应用，已有超过一百万名用户每天使用触发条件、操作和约束来自动化设备：例如在会议期间将手机静音、电量不足时关闭 WiFi、开车时朗读消息、到家后发送位置，以及完成数千种其他自动化任务。

此插件为 ChatGPT 提供完整的 MacroDroid 功能目录（包含 400 多种触发条件、操作和约束）、每种功能对应的准确 JSON 结构，以及一个可在你查看宏之前验证成品的校验器。只需说明想在什么情况下发生什么，例如“在日历事件期间将手机静音，结束后取消静音”。ChatGPT 会选择合适的功能、编写宏并进行验证。

将结果保存为 .macro 文件，在“宏”标签页中选择“导入”；或者将其粘贴到 remote.macrodroid.com 上的 MacroDroid AI Macro Builder，即可直接发送到手机。

无需账户或登录。你输入的内容不会被 MacroDroid 保存。

payload.name: Loadster
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Loadster helps users create and play test scripts, prepare load test scenarios, configure synthetic monitors, and investigate finished test and monitoring results through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Loadster 帮助用户创建和运行测试脚本、准备负载测试场景、配置合成监控，并通过 ChatGPT 调查已完成的测试和监控结果。

payload.name: RevenueCat
payload.description: 访问你的 RevenueCat 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Set up RevenueCat, integrate it in your apps, and access and analyze data about your customers, revenue, purchases.
payload.longDescription: 设置 RevenueCat 并将其集成到应用中，还可访问和分析有关客户、营收和购买的数据。

payload.name: Flowlines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Flowlines account to review AI agent activity, compare outcomes across time periods, investigate unsuccessful sessions, and analyze user cohorts. Use aggregate metrics, signals, topic maps, and focused session evidence to understand findings and identify product needs. Save independently verified findings as private workspace notes when requested. Requires a Flowlines account with access to a workspace containing agent data. Authorized results can include end-user conversation and activity data; responses should summarize evidence and mask direct personal identifiers. payload.name: doDomain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.
payload.longDescription:
doDomain 是一种“域名连接即服务”：它为产品提供引导式流程，让客户将自己的域名指向该产品，并负责处理背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。doDomain 插件可让 ChatGPT 通过你的账户处理这些工作：检查域名当前的 DNS 状态、列出团队配置的应用、列出已有域名连接、为客户创建新的连接会话、查询已启动的会话、在记录就绪后验证会话，以及对已发生漂移的连接重新运行验证。

访问通过 OAuth 2.1、PKCE 和动态客户端注册进行。用户可在授权同意界面按功能授予范围——域名、应用、连接和会话各自有独立的读写范围；对于未获授权的范围，助手不会获得相应工具。可随时在仪表板的 Connected Apps 页面撤销已连接应用。工具响应遵循严格限定的契约：绝不会返回秘密 API 密钥，而且插件完全无法访问 doDomain 的计费功能。

创建连接会话会计入套餐每月连接配额；验证检查受速率限制，因此同一连接重复验证时，系统会提示等待，而不会悄悄重试。

payload.longDescription:
Instant AI 基于 Instant Domain Search，帮助你查找域名并探索品牌创意。可在数百种域名后缀中检查一个名称，一次检查最多 50 个完整域名，生成 .com 替代选项，并搜索已编入索引的 USPTO 商标记录。

Instant AI 免费且只读，无需账户或 API 密钥。域名结果会链接到 instantdomainsearch.com 上的研究页面。注册状态来自我们的搜索索引，该索引每天根据注册局区域文件和 DNS 观测重建，而非实时查询注册局。商标结果会注明来源快照日期，不能据此认定商标已获得法律许可。

由 Instant Labs, Inc. 开发，该公司是 ICANN 认证的注册商（IANA 3952）。

payload.name: DEEPBOM Artifact Evidence
payload.description: 检查 AI 模型产物
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inspect attached AI model deployment files without executing model code. DEEPBOM analyzes supported TFLite, ONNX, GGUF, SafeTensors, Core ML, and ExecuTorch files in the browser and reports SHA-256, serialized structure, tensor encodings, quantization evidence, and static findings. Explore Model IR tables and visualizations, and export SVG, PNG, Word-ready bundles, CycloneDX 1.7 artifact evidence, or SPDX 2.3 artifact inventories. Use Send PNG to chat to share a selected visualization or Save via ChatGPT to obtain a download link for a generated file when supported by the host. These actions share the generated export, not the model file. Results separate artifact defects, cautions, and evidence gaps, and explain what static analysis cannot establish. Use the local CLI or local MCP for confidential, very large, sharded, or multi-file artifacts.
payload.longDescription: 无需执行模型代码，即可检查附加的 AI 模型部署文件。DEEPBOM 可在浏览器中分析受支持的 TFLite、ONNX、GGUF、SafeTensors、Core ML 和 ExecuTorch 文件，并报告 SHA-256、序列化结构、张量编码、量化证据和静态检查结果。探索 Model IR 表格和可视化内容，并导出 SVG、PNG、适用于 Word 的资料包、CycloneDX 1.7 产物证据或 SPDX 2.3 产物清单。在支持的宿主环境中，使用 Send PNG to chat 可分享选定的可视化内容；使用 Save via ChatGPT 可获取生成文件的下载链接。这些操作分享的是生成的导出文件，而非模型文件。结果会区分产物缺陷、注意事项和证据缺口，并说明静态分析无法确定的内容。对于机密、超大型、分片或多文件产物，请使用本地 CLI 或本地 MCP。

payload.name: Wolfire Workspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wolfire Workspace helps authorized game developers inspect their games, dated store checks, saved build provenance and release reports. Ask what needs attention and follow evidence back to the dashboard. Prepare public listing observations for review; saving requires confirmation in the dashboard. Requires an invited workspace account. This plugin does not run builds, download artifacts or publish releases.
payload.longDescription: Wolfire Workspace 帮助获授权的游戏开发者检查游戏、带日期的商店检查记录、已保存的构建来源信息和发行报告。询问哪些事项需要关注，并可沿证据追溯到仪表板。你可以准备公开商品页观察结果供审核；保存前必须在仪表板中确认。需要受邀加入工作区的账号。此插件不会运行构建、下载制品或发布版本。

payload.name: Gondwana
payload.description: 构建和调试 Gondwana 游戏
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, debug, and understand games made with the Gondwana C#/.NET game engine. The plugin uses Gondwana-specific workflows and read-only access to the current official repository, tests, demos, templates, and wiki so answers and generated code can be grounded in the engine's current public APIs.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Gondwana C#/.NET 游戏引擎构建、调试和理解游戏。此插件采用 Gondwana 专属工作流程，并以只读方式访问当前官方代码仓库、测试、演示、模板和 Wiki，因此回答和生成的代码可以基于该引擎当前公开的 API。

payload.name: Knowledge for Agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search public technical Problems, candidate Solutions, failed approaches, and observed Outcomes. Inspect exact revisions, applicability, limitations, and negative evidence before relying on a record. This connection provides four anonymous read tools. Guest discussion is separate public conversation; authenticated contributors with type-specific permissions publish ordinary Problems and Solutions directly through separate participation endpoints. Publication is not verification or reproduction.
payload.longDescription:
搜索公开的技术问题、候选解决方案、失败方法和观察到的结果。
在依赖记录前，请检查具体修订内容、适用性、限制和负面证据。
该功能提供四种匿名阅读工具。
游客讨论是独立的公开对话；经过身份验证的贡献者根据类型权限，通过独立参与端点直接发布常规问题和解决方案。
发布内容不表示验证或复现。

payload.name: ASO Skill
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ASO Skill helps app developers and marketers research current Apple App Store search rankings and keyword autocomplete, compare difficulty and popularity, inspect app metadata, and check account credits through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: ASO Skill 帮助应用开发者和营销人员通过 ChatGPT 研究当前 Apple App Store 搜索排名和关键词自动补全、比较难度与热度、查看应用元数据，以及查询账号额度。

payload.name: Pod
payload.description: 来自用户和代理的评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pod is a living index of what actually happens when people and agents use things. Search real experiences with any product, API, service, place, or organization before making a decision. Then share yours to help the next person or agent.
payload.longDescription: Pod 是一个持续更新的索引，记录人们和代理实际使用各种事物时的体验。在做决定前，搜索有关任意产品、API、服务、地点或组织的真实体验。然后分享您的经历，帮助下一位用户或代理。

payload.name: juudd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: juudd puts an AI-written project online without a second account to sign up for. Ask it to deploy, and you get a live site on your own subdomain with a Postgres database of its own — no build pipeline to configure, no dashboard to learn. Bring a project you already have: juudd accepts the files, serves them, and hands back a URL you can share. Custom domains, permanent versions with one-step rollback, and a plain record of every action taken on your account are included. Built for people who can direct an AI to write a working site but have never deployed one.
payload.longDescription: juudd 能让 AI 编写的项目上线，无需注册第二个账户。只要要求部署，就能在你自己的子域名上获得一个实时网站，并配有独立的 Postgres 数据库——无需配置构建流水线，也不用学习使用仪表板。你可以带来已有项目：juudd 接收文件、托管项目，并返回可分享的网址。还包含自定义域名、可一步回滚的永久版本，以及账户中每项操作的清晰记录。专为能够指挥 AI 编写可运行网站、但从未部署过网站的人打造。

payload.name: Prisma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Take your app from idea to a live URL with Prisma. Prisma brings together app hosting with Prisma Compute, managed databases with Prisma Postgres, and type-safe data access with Prisma ORM.

Build a new app with Prisma Composer or get an existing app ready for Compute. The plugin guides you through setup, local testing, and deployment, then checks that your live app works. Optional diagnostics use Prisma's MCP server to inspect deployment state and logs.

Requires ChatGPT's desktop app with local execution. Initially tested on macOS.

Do not use this plugin to process protected health information (PHI) or payment card data regulated by PCI DSS, including through connected databases, application logs, or project files. For healthcare or payment-related prototypes, use a separate environment containing synthetic data only.
payload.longDescription:
Prisma 可将应用从想法带到线上 URL：结合 Prisma Compute 应用托管、Prisma Postgres 托管数据库和 Prisma

ORM 类型安全的数据访问。使用 Prisma Composer 构建新应用，或让现有应用准备好在 Compute 上运行。插件会引导设置、本地测试和部署，然后检查线上应用是否正常；可选诊断使用 Prisma

MCP 服务器检查部署状态和日志。需要带本地执行功能的 ChatGPT

桌面应用，最初在 macOS 上测试。请勿使用此插件处理受保护健康信息（PHI）或 PCI DSS 监管的支付卡数据，包括连接数据库、应用日志或项目文件中的数据。医疗或支付相关原型应使用仅含合成数据的独立环境。

payload.name: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge lets authorized server owners inspect server health, work with approved files, and manage user-level processes from ChatGPT. Connections use OAuth with one-time owner pairing, and OpenAI reviewers receive a separate isolated demo environment.
payload.longDescription: AI-HIVE Remote Bridge让获授权的服务器所有者通过ChatGPT查看服务器健康状况、处理获批准的文件，并管理用户级进程。连接使用OAuth和一次性的所有者配对，OpenAI审核人员会获得一个独立隔离的演示环境。

payload.name: Cloudflare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cloudflare helps users search product documentation, discover API endpoints, and read, create, update, or delete resources across their Cloudflare accounts through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Cloudflare 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索产品文档、查找 API 端点，并跨其 Cloudflare 账户读取、创建、更新或删除资源。

payload.name: KERNEL
payload.description: 面向智能体的云浏览器
payload.summaryOriginal: a cloud browser for your agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: run cloud browsers from chatgpt. KERNEL gives your agent a real browser with full access to the internet: it can open any site, read and click through pages, fill out forms, and take screenshots. when a task needs one of your accounts, you sign in through a secure login panel that keeps passwords out of chat. each session runs in its own isolated cloud browser and shuts down when the task is done.
payload.longDescription: 从 ChatGPT 启动云浏览器。KERNEL 为你的智能体提供可访问整个互联网的真实浏览器：能够打开任意网站、阅读页面并点击操作、填写表单和截取屏幕截图。当任务需要使用你的账户时，你可以通过安全登录面板登录，密码不会进入聊天内容。每个会话都在独立隔离的云浏览器中运行，并会在任务完成后关闭。

payload.name: ApyHub US
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode generation, archive handling, and AI utilities. Search first to see what is available, review the endpoint details, then execute. Each endpoint returns its own cost and certification metadata.
payload.longDescription: 使用 ApyHub 为需要外部处理的任务查找和调用生产级 API。按功能搜索目录，然后调用适合的端点。涵盖文件转换（Word、PDF、Excel、图像）、文档生成、OCR 和文本提取、数据验证（电子邮件、电话、VAT、IBAN、税务 ID）、信息补充、地理定位和 IP 数据、货币和单位转换、二维码和条形码生成、归档文件处理，以及 AI 实用工具。先搜索可用功能，查看端点详情，再执行。每个端点都返回自己的费用和认证元数据。

payload.name: TokenLab
payload.description: 统一设计准则，适用于所有人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Define the design truth for a brand, product, or system. Turn it into tokens, guidance, and production outputs while people, automations, and AI contribute through one reviewable workflow. Use TokenLab in ChatGPT and Codex to explore workspaces, projects, libraries, modes, aliases, and releases, resolve tokens for implementation, and prepare governed changes on branches for human review.
payload.longDescription: 为品牌、产品或系统定义统一的设计准则。将其转化为设计令牌、指导规范和生产成果，让人员、自动化流程与 AI 在一个可审查的工作流中共同参与。通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 使用 TokenLab，探索工作区、项目、资源库、模式、别名和发布版本，解析用于实现的令牌，并在分支上准备受治理的更改，供人工审查。

payload.name: Simple Commenter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read and act on website and asset feedback from Simple Commenter in ChatGPT and Codex. Search authorized projects, inspect comments with available screenshots, element context, replies, and captured JavaScript errors, and turn feedback into concrete development tasks. With the appropriate permissions, update statuses and priorities, reply to feedback, create comments, and generate exports and reports. The included fix-feedback skill guides a coding agent through investigating and fixing selected issues when the relevant codebase is available. Requires a Simple Commenter account and project access. Features depend on your account plan and granted permissions.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中读取并处理 Simple Commenter 中的网站和素材反馈。搜索已授权项目，查看评论及可用截图、元素上下文、回复和捕获的 JavaScript 错误，并将反馈转化为具体开发任务。拥有相应权限时，可以更新状态和优先级、回复反馈、创建评论，并生成导出文件和报告。如果有相关代码库，随附的 fix-feedback 技能会指导编码智能体调查并修复选定问题。需要 Simple Commenter 账户和项目访问权限。可用功能取决于账户套餐及授予的权限。

payload.name: Altifigence
payload.description: 读取 Cloud 工作区上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse your Altifigence Cloud projects, inspect workspace details, and read saved source files in ChatGPT. Use your authorized project context to understand designs and discuss code. The integration provides read-only access to the workspaces you are permitted to view.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中浏览 Altifigence Cloud 项目、查看工作区详情，并读取已保存的源文件。使用获授权的项目上下文理解设计并讨论代码。此集成提供对你获准查看的工作区的只读访问。

payload.name: ProdVerity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProdVerity is a read-only production verification plugin for developers and operators. It checks whether a public HTTPS web app is reachable, inspects common security headers, discovers an optional ProdVerity verification manifest, runs deterministic public health checks, and can compare a public build marker with an expected commit or release identifier. It does not log in, modify target applications, access private networks, or claim visual verification.
payload.longDescription: ProdVerity 是面向开发人员和运维人员的只读生产环境验证插件。它会检查公开的 HTTPS Web 应用能否访问，检查常见安全标头，发现可选的 ProdVerity 验证清单，运行确定性的公开健康检查，并可将公开构建标记与预期的提交或发布标识进行比较。它不会登录、修改目标应用、访问私有网络，也不会声称进行了视觉验证。

payload.name: Web Performance Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Web Performance Insights runs Lighthouse performance audits on web pages through its tool service, displays scores and Core Web Vitals with historical trends, retrieves real-user Chrome UX Report field data, compares or benchmarks multiple pages head-to-head, provides AI-powered recommendations to improve specific metrics, and exports audit results as downloadable PDF reports.
payload.longDescription: Web Performance Insights 通过其工具服务对网页运行 Lighthouse 性能审计，展示评分、Core Web Vitals 核心网页指标及历史趋势，检索真实用户 Chrome UX Report 现场数据，对多个页面进行并排比较或基准测试，提供由 AI 支持的具体指标优化建议，并将审计结果导出为可下载的 PDF 报告。

payload.name: Veille
payload.description: 电子邮件和 VAT 验证
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Veille is an email, domain, phone, IP, VAT, and IBAN validation API for ChatGPT. Check signups, invoices, and traffic before you trust them.

Email validation flags disposable inboxes, role accounts, and a 0-100 risk score. Email qualification adds SMTP and catch-all. Domain checks disposable and MX health. Phone validation covers E.164 carrier and virtual numbers. IP reputation detects VPN, proxy, Tor, and datacenter. VAT uses VIES. IBAN returns bank and BIC. Exchange rates come from the ECB.

Sign in with your Veille account when you connect. Calls use the same credits and quotas as app.veille.io.
payload.longDescription:
Veille 是面向 ChatGPT 的电子邮件、域名、电话、IP、VAT 和 IBAN 验证 API。在信任注册、发票和流量之前，先对其进行检查。

电子邮件验证会标记一次性邮箱、角色账户，并提供 0-100 风险评分。电子邮件资质检查还包括 SMTP 和 catch-all。域名检查一次性域名和 MX 状态。电话验证涵盖 E.164 运营商及虚拟号码。IP 信誉检测 VPN、代理、Tor 和数据中心。VAT 使用 VIES。IBAN 会返回银行和 BIC。汇率来自 ECB。

连接时请使用你的 Veille 账户登录。调用使用的额度和配额与 app.veille.io 相同。

payload.name: Componecat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Componecat is your organization's software catalog: every system, service, library, and API you run, with owners, dependencies, documentation, and endpoints in one place. This plugin gives ChatGPT direct access to that catalog.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your real software landscape: which team owns the billing service, what depends on the auth API, where the runbook for the payments gateway lives, or which endpoints a component exposes. Search takes precise filters, so one question can cover a whole slice of the catalog. Documentation for each component is available in full, including sections synced from Git, so you can read it and reason about it without leaving the conversation.

You can also keep the catalog current from chat: add or update components, record relationships, attach documentation links, and review recent activity.

Componecat's own product documentation is included too, so ChatGPT can explain how the platform works and walk you through it.

A Componecat account is required. Catalogs are private to your organization, and you sign in with your existing account when connecting.
payload.longDescription:
Componecat 是您组织的软件目录：您运行的每个系统、服务、库和 API，以及对应负责人、依赖项、文档和端点，全部集中一处。此插件让 ChatGPT 直接访问该目录。

用自然语言提问，获取真实软件版图中的答案：计费服务由哪个团队负责、哪些组件依赖身份验证 API、支付网关的运行手册在哪里，或某组件暴露哪些端点。搜索支持精确筛选，因此一个问题即可覆盖目录中的完整切片。每个组件的文档都可完整访问，包括从 Git 同步的章节，您无需离开对话即可阅读并进行推理。

您还可以在聊天中保持目录更新：添加或更新组件、记录关系、附加文档链接并查看近期活动。

Componecat 自身产品文档也包含在内，因此 ChatGPT 可以解释平台工作方式并引导您使用。

需要 Componecat 账户。目录对您的组织私有，连接时使用现有账户登录。

payload.name: 방위사업 법령 도우미
payload.summaryOriginal: 방위사업 관련 공개 법령과 판례 검색
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
방위사업 업무와 관련된 공개 법령, 행정규칙, 판례 및 결정례를 검색하고 질문과 관련된 문서명과 조문·판단 근거를 확인하도록 돕습니다.

국가법령정보센터 Open API와 방위사업청 공개 자료를 활용하며, 개인 개발자가 독립적으로 운영합니다. 
방위사업청·법제처·OpenAI가 제작하거나 후원·승인한 서비스가 아닙니다.

조회 결과는 업무 검토를 위한 참고자료입니다. 최종 판단은 담당자가 원문과 사실관계를 확인 후 판단 바랍니다.
payload.longDescription:
帮助搜索防务事业相关的公开法律法规、行政规则、判例和决定案例，并查看与问题相关的文件名称、条款及判断依据。

使用国家法令信息中心 Open API 和防务事业厅公开资料，由个人开发者独立运营。
本服务并非由防务事业厅、法制处或 OpenAI 制作、赞助或认可。

查询结果仅供业务审查参考。最终判断前，请由负责人核对原文和事实情况。

payload.name: dbt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: dbt MCP Server helps users inspect dbt projects, query dbt Semantic Layer metrics, review lineage and model metadata, run dbt commands, manage dbt Platform jobs, generate dbt boilerplate, and search official dbt documentation through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: dbt MCP Server 帮助用户检查 dbt 项目、查询 dbt Semantic Layer 指标、查看数据血缘和模型元数据、运行 dbt 命令、管理 dbt Platform 作业、生成 dbt 样板代码，并通过 ChatGPT 搜索 dbt 官方文档。

payload.name: Retool
payload.description: 构建和部署 Retool 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Retool environment remotely. Build, edit, and deploy apps, and perform administrative tasks.
payload.longDescription: 远程管理你的 Retool 环境。构建、编辑和部署应用，并执行管理任务。

payload.name: OneSignal
payload.description: 设置电子邮件、推送和短信
payload.summaryOriginal: Set up email, push, and SMS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OneSignal helps authenticated workspace users inspect messaging and audience data, manage users and templates, create segments, send notifications, and configure email delivery workflows through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: OneSignal帮助经过身份验证的工作区用户查看消息和受众数据，管理用户和模板，创建用户群体，发送通知，并通过ChatGPT配置电子邮件交付工作流程。

payload.name: Cortex — Semantic Memory
payload.description: 为 AI 提供共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cortex gives ChatGPT a durable memory that survives across conversations. Save decisions and notes, search them by meaning, and get a synthesized recall of what's known on a topic — always with traceable sources. When new information contradicts what you saved, Cortex flags the conflict instead of silently overwriting it. Your data stays bound to your own subscription account. A SKYNETLAB product, patent-protected and in production.
payload.longDescription: Cortex 为 ChatGPT 提供可跨对话保留的持久记忆。保存决策和笔记，按含义搜索，并获取对某个主题已知信息的综合回顾——始终附有可追溯的来源。当新信息与已保存内容冲突时，Cortex 会标记冲突，而不会悄然覆盖旧内容。你的数据仅与你自己的订阅账户绑定。此产品由 SKYNETLAB 开发，受专利保护，已投入生产使用。

payload.name: AgentiSend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AgentiSend is a transactional email API: send through verified domains with a message log, a free preflight that runs every gate a real send runs, and refusals that name the fix. Built so an agent can send on your behalf without ever exceeding a budget a person set. Unsolicited mail is refused by design; there is no tool for it.
payload.longDescription: AgentiSend是一款事务性邮件API：通过已验证的域名发送邮件，提供消息日志、执行真实发送全部检查关卡的免费预检查，以及明确指出修复方法的拒绝说明。它旨在让智能体代表你发送邮件，同时绝不超出人为设定的预算。系统按设计拒绝未经请求的邮件，也没有用于发送这类邮件的工具。

payload.name: Spacefast
payload.description: 构建并分享你的AI工作成果
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and share your AI work
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Publish the pages, reports, dashboards, and other artifacts you create with ChatGPT and get a link to share them. Spacefast lets you update existing sites, manage access, connect custom domains, and view or restore earlier versions. Connect your Spacefast account to manage your team's Spaces from the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT创建的页面、报告、仪表板和其他成果，生成可分享的链接。Spacefast支持更新现有网站、管理访问权限、连接自定义域名、查看或恢复早期版本。连接您的Spacefast账户，即可从对话中管理团队的Spaces。

payload.name: Samva
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Samva helps product teams inspect email readiness and delivery activity, send transactional email, and manage domains, senders, webhooks, templates, scheduled messages, and campaigns through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Samva 帮助产品团队通过 ChatGPT 检查电子邮件就绪状态和投递活动、发送事务性电子邮件，并管理域名、发件人、webhook、模板、定时消息和营销活动。

payload.name: Light Remote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Light Remote lets users connect ChatGPT to explicitly authorized devices they own, inspect device topology and effective policy, open durable sessions, work with files and Git, run bounded commands and managed processes, use real PTY/ConPTY terminals, recover job output after interruptions, and manage Main/Fleet device authority without silently switching targets.
payload.longDescription: Light Remote 让用户可以将 ChatGPT 连接到自己明确授权的设备，检查设备拓扑和有效策略，开启持久会话，处理文件和 Git，运行受限命令及托管进程，使用真实 PTY/ConPTY 终端，在中断后恢复作业输出，并管理 Main/Fleet 设备权限，而不会悄悄切换目标设备。

payload.name: Impreza Host
payload.description: 部署应用并管理服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Impreza Host is privacy-first offshore hosting. Connect your account and work with your infrastructure right in the conversation: list your servers, deploy an app from the curated catalog or straight from a git repository, follow the deploy and read container logs when something fails, manage domains and DNS records, control VPS power, snapshots and backups, and check invoices and balance.

Every tool acts only on the account you authenticate with, and the OAuth scope you grant (read, deploy or manage) decides what is callable. Read-only tools are labelled as such; anything that erases a disk, interrupts a live machine or affects billing is labelled destructive, so it can be confirmed with you before it runs. Purchases are completed on our checkout page, not inside the chat.
payload.longDescription:
Impreza Host 提供以隐私为先的离岸托管服务。关联账户后，你可以直接在对话中管理基础设施：列出服务器，从精选目录或 Git 仓库部署应用，在部署过程中查看进度，并在发生故障时阅读容器日志；管理域名和 DNS 记录；控制 VPS 电源、快照和备份；以及查看发票和余额。

每个工具仅操作你认证的账户，授予的 OAuth 权限范围（读取、部署或管理）决定可以调用哪些功能。只读工具会明确标注；擦除磁盘、中断运行中的机器或影响计费的操作会标记为破坏性操作，执行前可与你确认。购买需在我们的结账页面完成，不能在聊天中进行。

payload.name: Not Just You
payload.description: AI 服务状态，来源分开呈现
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check AI service status across official provider notices, community reports, and opt-in installed-client signals. Sources stay separate so you can compare the evidence yourself.
Read-only, no account required, and never reads prompts, files, credentials, or messages.
payload.longDescription:
通过官方服务商公告、社区报告和用户自愿提供的已安装客户端信号，查看 AI 服务状态。各来源分别呈现，方便你自行比较证据。
只读，无需账户，且绝不读取提示词、文件、凭据或消息。

payload.name: Swigs Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Swigs Cloud puts your project online in a single sentence. Give it a GitHub repository: the connector detects the framework, builds the project and publishes it over HTTPS on servers located Switzerland. You can then check the status of your sites, read deployment logs, manage environment variables and roll back to a previous version without leaving the conversation. Your data never leaves Swiss territory, backups included, and prices are in Swiss francs.
payload.longDescription: 只需一句话，Swigs Cloud 就能将你的项目上线。提供 GitHub 仓库后，连接器会识别框架、构建项目，并通过位于瑞士的服务器以 HTTPS 发布。之后，你可以直接在对话中查看网站状态、阅读部署日志、管理环境变量，并回滚到之前的版本。你的数据始终留在瑞士境内，备份也不例外；价格以瑞士法郎计价。

payload.name: GraphOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Apollo's official documentation, read documentation pages, and use the Apollo Connectors specification. Sign in to inspect GraphOS graphs, including variants, launches, lint results, persisted query status, and operation, client, and subgraph metrics.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Apollo 官方文档、阅读文档页面并使用 Apollo Connectors 规范。登录后可检查 GraphOS 图谱，包括变体、发布、lint 检查结果、持久化查询状态，以及操作、客户端和子图指标。

payload.name: nowyourlink Developer Docs
payload.description: 阅读 API 集成文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read published nowyourlink developer documentation in ChatGPT. Understand public API authentication, pagination, errors, request limits, versioning and privacy boundaries while building an integration. This documentation connection does not retrieve advertisements, access accounts, place bids or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中阅读已发布的 nowyourlink 开发者文档。构建集成时了解公共 API 的身份验证、分页、错误、请求限制、版本控制和隐私边界。此文档连接不会检索广告、访问账户、出价或处理付款。

payload.name: AstraVerify Domain Trust Check
payload.description: 电子邮件与AI发现性检查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AstraVerify checks whether a domain is trustworthy in the two places that matter today: the inbox and the AI answer. Ask about any domain and it returns two scores out of 100. Email Security covers MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, including whether DMARC is actually enforced, and every finding comes with the exact TXT record to paste. Discoverability covers what search engines and AI crawlers can actually get from the site: robots.txt rules for Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, whether the CDN blocks them at the edge, the sitemap, www/apex redirects, canonical tags, titles and descriptions, Organization and WebSite structured data, llms.txt, and whether the opening paragraphs define the brand. A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.
payload.longDescription:
AstraVerify会检查域名在当今两个关键场景中的可信度：邮箱收件箱和AI回答。用户可查询任意域名，系统将返回两项满分均为100的评分。邮件安全模块涵盖MX、SPF、DKIM和DMARC检查，包括DMARC是否真正生效，每个检测结果均附带可直接粘贴的精确TXT记录。可发现性模块则检测搜索引擎和AI爬虫实际能获取的内容：Googlebot、Bingbot、GPTBot、ClaudeBot、OAI-SearchBot和PerplexityBot的robots.txt规则，CDN是否在边缘节点屏蔽爬虫，站点地图、www/域名重定向、规范标签、标题描述、组织结构数据和网页结构数据，llms.txt文件，以及首页段落是否明确定义品牌定位。提供模拟爬虫抓取工具可查看指定爬虫的实际响应结果，修改后可通过verify_fix功能重新检测特定区域。评分规则与astraverify.com完全一致，确保助手说明与关联的报告页面内容完全匹配。服务器仅读取公开的DNS和页面内容，不会登录您的域名，也不会向域名写入数据，无需账户即可使用：结果会缓存并共享，每个域名的完整扫描频率受限制。
专为创始人、市场负责人、IT通用工程师以及管理多个域名的机构设计。

payload.name: Tailor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tailor lets ChatGPT read Tailor Platform's public documentation and answer questions about building on it, grounded in the published docs rather than training data.

Tailor Platform is a headless ERP platform: define your data model, workflows, and permissions in code with the Tailor SDK, and get a GraphQL API, TailorDB, StateFlow workflows, Pipelines, Auth, and an App Shell for building business applications.

What this plugin does:
- search_knowledge: find documentation pages whose body text mentions a term, with an excerpt and a link for each hit
- list_knowledge: browse the table of contents by source or section
- fetch_knowledge: read a page as Markdown, or one section of a long page

Every answer can cite the exact page on docs.tailor.tech.

No account, sign-in, or token is required. The plugin only reads Tailor's published documentation; it cannot access any customer's application, data, or workspace. All tools are read-only.

Good for: developers evaluating or building on Tailor Platform, teams writing tailor.config.ts, and anyone asking how to do something in TailorDB, StateFlow, or the Tailor SDK.
payload.longDescription:
Tailor让ChatGPT可读取Tailor平台的公开文档，并基于已发布的文档而非训练数据，回答有关如何在其上开发的问题。

Tailor平台是一个无头ERP平台：通过Tailor SDK以代码定义数据模型、工作流和权限，即可获得GraphQL API、TailorDB、StateFlow工作流、Pipelines、认证功能，以及用于构建业务应用的App Shell。

此插件的功能包括：
- search_knowledge：查找正文包含特定术语的文档页面，每个匹配结果均附有摘要和链接
- list_knowledge：按来源或章节浏览目录
- fetch_knowledge：以Markdown格式读取页面内容，或仅获取长页面的某个章节

每个回答均可引用docs.tailor.tech上的具体页面。

无需账户、登录或令牌。
该插件仅读取Tailor已发布的文档；无法访问任何客户的程序、数据或工作区。
所有工具均为只读模式。

适用对象：评估或基于Tailor平台开发的开发者、编写tailor.config.ts文件的团队，以及询问如何在TailorDB、StateFlow或Tailor SDK中执行操作的用户。

payload.name: Blink
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Blink turns a description into a working app, with a database, sign-in, a backend and hosting, and publishes it to a live link. You do it all from this conversation.

What you can do:
• Build an app by describing it: a client portal, a booking site, an internal dashboard, a landing page or a mobile app.
• Change it by asking: "add a dark mode toggle" or "let clients approve deliverables".
• Answer Blink's questions right in the chat when it needs a decision, like which kind of app or which look.
• See the finished app right in the chat, with a screenshot and what changed, then publish it to a live URL.
• Look inside any project: list your projects, read the source at any saved version, compare two versions, query the database, and read backend logs when something fails.
• Restore an earlier version if a change went wrong.

How it works: connecting is a normal sign-in, and you choose which Blink workspace to grant. Code changes always go through Blink's agent, so your app's source and its saved versions stay in step. You can disconnect at any time from Blink Settings, Access Tokens, Connected apps.
payload.longDescription:
Blink通过描述生成可运行的应用程序，包含数据库、登录功能、后端和托管服务，并发布为实时链接。所有操作都通过此对话完成。

您可以：
• 通过描述构建应用：客户门户、预订网站、内部仪表板、着陆页或移动应用。
• 通过提问修改应用：如「添加暗色模式切换」或「让客户批准交付物」。
• 在聊天中直接回答Blink的问题以做出决策，例如选择应用类型或外观。
• 在聊天中查看完成的应用程序，包含截图和变更记录，然后发布为实时URL。
• 查看任何项目详情：列出您的项目，查看任一保存版本的源代码，对比两个版本，查询数据库，在出现故障时查看后端日志。
• 若更改出错，可恢复到早期版本。

工作原理：连接只需正常登录，并选择要授权的Blink工作区。代码更改始终通过Blink的代理进行，确保应用的源代码和保存版本保持同步。您可随时从Blink设置-访问令牌-已连接的应用中断开连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build and change apps by describing them, Answer the builder's questions in chat, Publish an app to a live URL, List projects with screenshots and status, Read source code at any saved version, Compare two versions, Query an app's database, Read backend logs, Restore an earlier version

payload.name: TokenOS Tokenomics Designer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe your token and get a complete tokenomics model: allocation buckets with token amounts, vesting (TGE unlock, cliff, linear), a month-by-month circulating-supply schedule rendered as a chart, FDV and initial market cap at a launch price, and warnings where the design deviates from what buyers and exchanges expect. Presets for DeFi, gaming, meme, infrastructure and DAO tokens, or pass custom buckets.

Tools:
• design_tokenomics — Build a full allocation + vesting model with a 48-month circulating-supply schedule, FDV / initial market cap and sanity warnings.
• vesting_schedule — Month-by-month unlock table for one allocation given TGE unlock %, cliff and linear vesting months.

Targets questions like: “tokenomics template”; “token allocation calculator”; “token vesting schedule calculator”; “tokenomics design”; “token distribution model”; “token unlock schedule”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/tokenomics-designer

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
payload.longDescription:
描述您的代币并获取完整的代币经济模型：包含代币数量的分配桶、锁定期（TGE解锁比例、禁售期、线性解锁周期）、按月呈现的流通量计划表（以图表形式呈现）、基于发行价格的FDV（完全稀释价值）和初始市值，并在设计偏离买家和交易所预期时发出警告。提供针对DeFi、游戏、模因、基础设施和DAO代币的预设方案，或可自定义分配桶。

工具：
• design_tokenomics — 通过48个月流通量计划表、FDV/初始市值和合理性警告，构建完整的分配+锁定期模型。
• vesting_schedule — 根据TGE解锁比例、禁售期和线性解锁月数，生成单个分配桶的月度解锁表格。

解决的问题包括：「代币经济模板」；「代币分配计算器」；「代币锁定期计算器」；「代币经济设计」；「代币分发模型」；「代币解锁计划」。

文档：https://tokenos.ai/mcp/tokenomics-designer

输出内容仅为信息参考 — 包括链上读取、确定性计算工具和启发式扫描 — 并非财务、法律或安全建议。
TokenOS采用非托管模式，从不持有密钥或资金；您发起的任何部署或签名操作均通过您自己的钱包完成。

information.value: Allocation tables with token amounts, Cliff and linear vesting schedules, 48-month circulating supply charts, FDV and initial market cap

payload.name: TokenOS Wallet Inspector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Look up any Solana wallet address to see its SOL balance, every SPL and Token-2022 holding with live USD values, and recent activity. Read-only: nothing to connect or sign.

• check_token — Return supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, metadata mutability, top-20 holders with concentration, and a heuristic rug-risk score for a token mint.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/wallet-inspector

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
payload.longDescription:
查询任何Solana钱包地址，查看其SOL余额、所有SPL和Token-2022代币持仓的实时美元价值以及最近交易记录。
粘贴代币铸造地址获取供应量、价格、市值、铸造/冻结权限状态、前十大持仓者集中度及通俗易懂的风险评估报告。
粘贴交易签名获取交易解析结果。

适用于以下查询：
「检查Solana钱包」
「查看Solana钱包余额」
「该钱包持有哪些代币」
「该代币是否为跑路代币」
「Solana代币持仓者」
「Solana交易解析」

文档地址：https://tokenos.ai/mcp/wallet-inspector

输出内容仅供参考——包括链上数据读取、确定性计算和启发式扫描结果，不构成财务、法律或安全建议。
TokenOS采用非托管模式，永不持有密钥或资金；您发起的任何部署或签名操作均通过自身钱包完成。

payload.name: EmpirioLabs AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
EmpirioLabs AI connects ChatGPT to your EmpirioLabs account, so you can use its catalog of more than 180 AI models from a conversation.

What you can do:
- Chat with text and multimodal models, create embeddings, rerank documents, and get yes/no or multiple-choice answers from decision models.
- Generate and edit images, and create video, speech, music, sound effects and 3D assets.
- Transcribe audio and analyze images.
- Search the web and get grounded answers with their sources.
- Run agent tasks, submit batch jobs, follow generation jobs, and review your account usage.

Who it is for: developers and creators who use EmpirioLabs and want its models inside ChatGPT.

Limitations: an EmpirioLabs account is required, and each request runs on that account. Longer generations return a job that the app checks until the result is ready. Account settings and API keys are managed in the EmpirioLabs dashboard.
payload.longDescription:
EmpirioLabs AI将ChatGPT连接到您的EmpirioLabs账户，您就可以通过对话使用其超过180种AI模型的目录。

您可以：
- 与文本和多模态模型聊天，生成嵌入，重新排序文档，并从决策模型获取是/否或多项选择答案。
- 生成和编辑图像，创建视频、语音、音乐、音效和3D资源。
- 语音转文字并分析图像。
- 搜索网络并获取带来源的有依据答案。
- 运行代理任务，提交批量作业，跟踪生成任务，并查看您的账户使用情况。

适用于：使用EmpirioLabs的开发者和创作者，希望在ChatGPT中使用其模型。

限制条件：需要一个EmpirioLabs账户，每个请求都在该账户下运行。
长时间生成会返回一个任务，应用会持续检查直到结果就绪。
账户设置和API密钥在EmpirioLabs仪表板中管理。

payload.name: Bits & Bolts Remote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore MCP Extensions through an interactive CAD parts library in ChatGPT and Codex. Browse sample parts, inspect CAD files, and try sidebar apps, file viewers, composer mentions, forms, settings, citations, and deep links. Available features depend on host support.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT和Codex中的交互式CAD零件库探索MCP扩展功能。浏览示例零件、检查CAD文件，并尝试侧边栏应用、文件查看器、Composer提及、表单、设置、引用和深度链接。可用功能取决于主机支持。

payload.name: Vibecode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vibecode turns a conversation into a real, native iPhone app.

Describe what you want to make, like a calorie tracker, a habit app or a simple game, and ChatGPT turns it into a build brief for Vibecode. You can follow the build right in the chat, including Vibecode's agent testing the app on an iPhone simulator. When it's done, the finished app runs on a live simulator inside ChatGPT, so you can tap through it before you go anywhere else.

When you're ready to keep going, open the project in Vibecode on the web, scan a QR code to open it in the Vibecode iPhone app, or start publishing it to the App Store from Vibecode.

Ask for changes to an app you've built, like a new screen, a different color or a fix, and Vibecode's agent makes them and tests them, right in the chat. Ask to see your Vibecode apps at any time to pick up an app you've already built.

Connect your Vibecode account when ChatGPT asks; every app you build lives in that account.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: 1F916
payload.description: 记录AI代理接收到的指令内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.
payload.longDescription:
1F916会创建可验证篡改的记录，记载AI代理接收到的指令及其执行操作。在执行操作前，助手会记录下收到的指令及即将采取的行动。执行完成后，会将结果追加到同一记录中。该功能还可对记忆进行密封，使后续会话能验证内容是否被修改。

每条记录都会被链接至公共日志。每隔数分钟，注册机构会对整份日志进行签名，独立见证人会共同签署这些签名，并将副本发送至比特币（OpenTimestamps）和Base链。任何后续篡改记录的行为都会导致与已发布签名不匹配，用户可通过该应用返回的包含性证明和一致性证明进行验证。

默认情况下仅公开指纹信息（SHA-256）。原始文本由您自行保管，或加密存储至您的密钥中。

该应用不涉及资金流转，也不会调用1F916注册机构以外的外部服务。阅读操作无需登录，写入操作只需完成一次身份验证：将助手注册为拥有独立1F916账号的代理，或连接已存在的账号。
